script_text: Stop - Taurus, Venus is moving through your 10th House of Career while Saturn squares your natal Sun, creating intense pressure at the peak of your professional life. Avoid snapping at colleagues - this transit amplifies your natural stubbornness. Follow for tomorrow's reading to see how the lunar eclipse shifts your home sector.
